headword: {千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}
gloss: doing a roaring trade; a constant stream of customers

definitions.gloss: a constant stream of customers; doing a roaring trade
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing a shop or business visited by an endless flow of customers. Literally 'a thousand guests, ten thousand comings.'

examples.japanese: {千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}で{大繁盛|だいはんじょう}だ。
examples.english: Customers keep pouring in and business is booming.

examples.japanese: {新装開店|しんそうかいてん}の{店|みせ}は{千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}のにぎわいだった。
examples.english: The newly reopened shop was bustling with a constant stream of customers.

examples.japanese: {招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}を{置|お}くと{千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}になると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that placing a beckoning cat brings a steady flood of customers.

notes:
A celebratory idiom used to describe or wish for a business thronged with customers. Frequently appears alongside {商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう} on lucky charms and shop decorations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}を{願|ねが}う: to wish for a stream of customers
- {千|せん}{客|きゃく}{万|ばん}{来|らい}のにぎわい: bustle of endless customers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}: prosperous business — emphasizes overall commercial success rather than the crowd of customers itself
